design: Rear of the accepted charcoal welding face shield: horizontal suspension band, crown strap and side hinges/edges. The front visor faces away and is not visible. The canonical bald scalp remains visible between straps. No new body-specific helmet design.
scope: North standing plus eight walking poses on each body. South already approved. East/mirrored West, side settling, wrench and runtime promotion remain pending.

reference_image.usage_description: Approved SAME character wearing charcoal welding face shield from FRONT. Design/colors only: produce the REAR of this item on the North-facing input. Do not turn the input body/head around.

request.description: Add the REAR VIEW of the reference's lowered charcoal-gray classic welding face shield to this exact NORTH-facing standing character. Viewer sees the BACK OF THE BALD HEAD, not a face. Shield is in front of the wearer, facing AWAY: no visor/window/eyes visible from the back. Show a simple dark charcoal horizontal suspension HEADBAND around the back of the head at ear level, a narrow gray crown strap up the middle, small dark side hinges at either temple and a slim charcoal shield edge at each side. Back of bald scalp remains visible between straps. This is one practical unisex rigid mask, restrained 3-tone neutral charcoal palette, squared straight shield edges consistent with reference. No orange/gold/rust, no round metal dome or full helmet shell, no goggles or rear window, no gasmask, backpack or extra clothing. Fit EXACT existing head pixels (near x17..31,y8..21), keep original scalp/human shape and all body/neck/shoulders/arms/legs/feet/canvas coordinates unchanged. Ground pivot24,58; transparent48x64 nativecanvas. No head resizing or recentering. Only headgear pixels; full fitted source for overlay extraction onto unchanged base.
request.input: Exact canonical North standing crop [192,0,48,64] from male/base.png.

generation.sourceInput: Canonical male/base.png crop [192,0,48,64], lossless native pixels passed as base64.
generation.derivatives: Exact pixelart_workbench exports. No object animator or AI walk generation; rigid gear follows measured head positions.

extraction.method: Copy only inspected rear gear pixels at native coordinates; palette map to approved charcoal ramp. Preserve skin showing through suspension gaps from the original canonical body, never generated anatomy.
extraction.sharedArt: The same rigid rear suspension fits both standing heads at native coordinates. Reused only after separate compositions were checked. Body-specific sheets retain their own head offsets and separate approval.
extraction.occlusion: No extra body-clear pixels needed in North; opaque gear covers the head where present. All other canonical pixels remain unchanged.
extraction.motion: Translate the rigid generated mask with measured integer head attachment, without resizing/warping or shifting fabric to force a fit.

headMeasurement.metric: Minimum RGBA mismatch against that body's standing North head, ignoring RGB under alpha zero.
headMeasurement.existingVisibleChanges: Small original scalp shade differences remain visible on some walk poses; no base pixels were corrected or regenerated.

verification.automated: PASS: all 18 poses exactly reproduce 136 source-selected/mapped gear pixels at measured head offsets, with binary alpha and native dimensions; original scalp/body pixels and approved jacket compositions preserved. All 92 file hashes match (85 preserved, 7 new). Six 432x64 sheets plus one 48x64 raw fitted source.

Side mask facings remain hidden; accepted 28-step jacket transitions retained. No browser rendering claim.
